we were able to achieve a real time object detection app that runs natively, is wifi independent, and can be used in a variety of languages.

while there is a tradeoff between speed and accuracy, it is possible to achieve high performance in both categories.
while there is still much work to be done to improve the speed of CNNs, the current state of the art is sufficient enough to run a CNN on mobile in real-time.
